text:
ConocoPhillips jumped 2.7% today as oil prices surged and refining profits expanded sharply. Global crude prices are elevated — US oil at $103/barrel and world oil at $123/barrel — and refining margins widened after Ukrainian and Iranian strikes disrupted refinery capacity in Russia and the Middle East, driving diesel prices higher. This is exactly the environment where an integrated oil and gas company with refining operations benefits from both higher crude values and fatter refining spreads.

The move fits into a broader two-week rally (up 5% since mid-October) as geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and Eastern Europe keep energy markets tight and supply disruptions real. With major oil earnings reports coming this week, today's jump likely reflects confidence that higher prices and refining profits will show up in strong third-quarter results.
